status: Specification only; owner acceptance required; no runtime data, execution or PASS

workspace.initialization: Normal built workspace/project/board commands; fresh identities/unused explicit numeric-loopback port. Record exact tuples and commands privately.
workspace.identity: Generate installation/board/incarnation/card/actor/grant IDs normally; aliases below are recipe labels, never literal UUIDs.

actors.assignment: Use only actors initialized for that board. Human/bot labels do not grant rights; do not introduce enrollment or grant-administration work.

historySeed.method: One normal card create, then 25 successful comment.add operations with current expected revision, alternating normal human browser and actual CLI bot. Capture IDs/revisions/attribution.
historySeed.continuation: Current state shown separately; current-origin prior snapshots cardRevision descending, then retained other origins ordered by originBoard/originIncarnation with descending revision within each. Full provenance retained; comments createdAt ascending then commentId. Local presentation of complete validated reads; no query/cursor extension.
historySeed.reset: Fresh scenario/run or declared normal-command reset; do not reuse initial counts after edits.
